verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents who handles the appointment: it completes the registered-agent switch paperwork and changes the agent information with your Secretary of State. It also says its address replaces yours on public records. It does not publish per-state details, such as the agent address in each state or the specific designation form per state. Missing for 10: per-state agent address listings, per-state identification of the form that designates the agent, a state-by-state statement of who files, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider publishes per-state appointment details: the agent address for that state, which form designates the agent, and who files it

citations.quote: We'll also change the registered agent information with your Secretary of State.
All paperwork needed to switch RAs completed for you, plus state fees covered
Our address is listed as the registered agent on public records instead of yours
